annotations.title: Redact Israeli personal details from text

description: Hides Israeli personal details in a text: ID numbers (checksum-validated), credit cards, bank accounts and IBAN, phone numbers, e-mails, street addresses, names after a salutation or label, car plates, birth dates. Returns the redacted text and counts per kind, never the hidden values. Use before storing, summarising or forwarding a letter or document that may contain someone's details. | הסתרת פרטים אישיים מטקסט. Stateless: arguments and results are never stored, logged or shared (nayeret.ai/developers/). Not legal or tax advice.

also_hide.description: Extra exact words or numbers to hide

keep_words.description: Words to leave visible even if detected (e.g. the user's own company name)

kinds.description: Only these kinds (default: all except case numbers). id, card, bank, iban, phone, email, address, name, plate (car), dob (birth date), caseno (case/reference numbers)

lang.description: Language of the summary text: he (default) or en. Files stay in Hebrew (official forms and Israeli letters).

text.description: The text to redact (up to 20000 characters). Processed in memory only; never stored or logged.

name: redact_text
